title: SDLC orchestration handoff record
description: One JSON file per handoff between orchestration subagents, stored as docs/handoffs/<bucket-slug>-<from>-to-<to>.json

from.description: Agent name handing off, e.g. business-analyst

artifact.description: Path to the artifact being handed off, e.g. docs/buckets/my-task/srs.md

gate_conditions.description: Named conditions that must hold for approval_status to be approved, e.g. all_user_stories_have_acceptance_criteria

unmet_conditions.description: Subset of gate_conditions not yet satisfied; non-empty implies approval_status must not be approved
